title: skills: teach kanban.lanes in the objectstack-ui list-views rule
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #28196 (#28018), filed by the seat before ACCEPT as the claim template requires. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: an AI author writing a kanban view from the `objectstack-ui` skill does not learn `lanes`, so it cannot drop an always-empty lane or order lanes.

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` (the kanban example at ≈L275, beside `groupByField` / `summarizeField`) shows `lanes`: the stored option values to draw, in order. Not a record filter (an unlisted value lands in `Uncategorized`; filter the view to keep records off the board). Lint refuses a non-option or repeated lane.
- Lands with or after the renderer card for #28018, so the skill never teaches a key that draws nothing. Governed path (`skills/**`): Tier H.

Links back: #28018, PR #28196.

Blocked-by: #28211
